answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the umber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cipher holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
